text:
She who died of her blue dress is singing.

She sings imbued with death beneath the sun of her drunkenness.


Inside her song there is a blue dress, there is

a white horse, there is a green heart tattooed

with the echoes of the beatings of her dead

heart.


Exposed to all perdition, she

sings beside a lost girl who is herself:

her good-luck charm. And despite the

green fog on her lips and the gray cold in her

eyes, her voice corrodes the distance that opens between

thirst and the hand that seeks the glass.


She sings.

translation.title: Night Singer
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the blue, white, green, and gray color sequence around the singer.
